scheme_name: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses
other_conditions: The applicant must be a girl student
Parents/Husband/Guardian must be domiciled residents of the UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
The student must have studied continuously for five years in any High School/Higher Secondary School in the UT, including the qualifying examination (SSC/HSC)
Only the first two daughters of a family are eligible for benefits
benefits_summary: Provides full or partial tuition fee reimbursement (up to ₹2.5‑3.5 lakh per year) and a hostel allowance of up to ₹30,000 per year for eligible girl students pursuing diploma, undergraduate or postgraduate professional courses.
